description: Revenant launch, tracer homing and spatially consistent forced placement; full actor dispatcher and playable game remain unfinished.

decisions.reference: Unmodified original A_Tracer compiled as host C with a controlled puff call and angle query; actual canonical smoke timers/tables are used. All 25 fields and ordered events match.
scope: Quarter-turn approach, exact-angle boundaries and unsigned wrap
Live/dead/missing targets, zero/near/far distances and vertical slope
Game-tic modulo-four gating and all random starts
Smoke position, velocity, timers and RNG after the controlled puff boundary
96 shadow/non-shadow launches with independent integer-table/RNG expected results
Temporary raised source height is restored on success and callback/owner exceptions
Initial half-step plus extra step, tracer/source handles and spatial metadata
Eight actual puff/smoke/homing gates, including stale targets and independent level/game clocks
Six ownership/inactive/exception guards with complete fresh-task cleanup
162 placements across BSP axis ties, all grid boundaries and outside-grid coordinates, with and without NOBLOCKMAP
Exact point-sector floor/ceiling and removal from prior block chains
Forced overlap/height bypass and owner/inactive atomic guards

nativeDesign: EnemyTracer receives the persistent game tick explicitly; the paused/resettable level tick is not substituted.

Forced placement refreshes coordinates, sector, floor/ceiling and block ownership together, including the revenant extra step. Original direct C coordinate edits can retain prior spatial metadata until another move.
Tracer puffs use the normal puff animation explicitly. They do not inherit the original shared attackrange variable and its prior punch-animation selection.
remaining: Complete actor action dispatcher and persistent game-clock host
Native host input/render pacing and UI/audio
